source.label: Accountable Noon real-time proof-of-solvency dashboard API

observations.attestationStructure: Signed snapshot attestation (liability and collateral hashes with signatures), zero-knowledge proof bundle, Merkle root signed at 2026-07-27T22:45:43.089Z, one zkTLS attestation, nitro enclave attestation.

valuationCadenceDays.formula: (snapshot.ts of fetch 2 - snapshot.ts of fetch 1) in ms converted to days; consecutive signed attestation snapshots observed 7 wall-clock minutes apart

derivations.collateralizationCheck: totalReservesUsd / totalSupplyUsn = 1.0137861, matching the published collateralization field

valuationCadenceDays.rationale: Self-described 'live' feed with 100% verifiability; two consecutive signed attestation snapshots (22:30:40.217Z and 22:45:43.200Z) pin a ~15-minute refresh, i.e. 0.0105 days.

weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: Searched the full Accountable dashboard API payload (deployment buckets, custody split, 609-point timeline, attestation bundle - no maturity fields), Noon's transparency docs, liquidity docs (per-strategy liquidity windows only: FTAC T+3 months, T-bills/CLOs T+0-T+3, lending/PT T+0), and USN/sUSN product docs. No position-level maturity dates, maturity ladder, or portfolio WAM is published; deriving a WAM from liquidity windows would be prohibited extrapolation. The disclosure should live in the Accountable dashboard position detail at https://noon.accountable.capital/.
